name: Create and Email Pennylane Invoices
description: Create a finalized Pennylane invoice from an authenticated request and wait for Pennylane to accept its email.
requirements: Self-hosted n8n with a synchronous HTTPS webhook
Pennylane company API token with customers:all and customer_invoices:all scopes
Authorized customer data, invoice inputs and email delivery
